channel.description: Latest articles from Paste Media Group (pastemagazine.com)

item.title: Pillion is the sweetest S&M movie since Secretary
item.description: In contrast to the kink-shaming history of mainstream cinema, Pillion normalizes the non-vanilla with its sweet BDSM romance.

item.title: Paul Thomas Anderson and Jonny Greenwood want Phantom Thread track removed from Melania
item.description: The Radiohead guitarist says he wasn't asked for permission to have his composition featured in the doc.

item.title: Sony's sports cartoon Goat knows just enough ball
item.description: Goat isn't as inventive as recent Sony-produced cartoons like Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse or KPop Demon Hunters, but it's a sweet-natured and fun-enough kids' movie.

item.title: Michael Shannon and Jason Narducy are becoming a part of R.E.M.’s legacy, one album at a time
item.description: Q&A: The Oscar-nominated actor and prolific guitarist sat down with Paste to talk about playing R.E.M. albums in full before taking Lifes Rich Pageant on the road this week.

item.title: I wasted 30 minutes of my life watching the Turning Point USA halftime show so you don’t have to
item.description: It’s hard to mount a culture war when your big counteroffensive looks like a youth-group lock-in made up of kids who found God in a megachurch but lost their personality somewhere in suburban Atlanta.​

item.title: Wuthering Heights trades transgression for tradition, finding the worst of both worlds
item.description: Overlong and undersexed, Emerald Fennell's Wuthering Heights betrays her audience of edgelords and perverts.

item.title: The least powerful people in Casey Wasserman’s world are paying the ultimate price
item.description: Mid‑tier acts like Wednesday and Sleigh Bells are scrambling to hold onto health insurance and rent while the man whose name is in the Epstein files gets to remain their boss.

item.title: Fairweather fans abandon Iron Lung and Melania at weekend box office
item.description: Last week's hit makers, Markiplier and Melania Trump, stumbled this week as fans weren't interested in seconds.
